name: halloweenpuppet
description: Browser Halloween motion-capture puppet: MediaPipe, VRM, music playback, WebM recording

scripts.dev:split: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server -- --api-only" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
